items.description: Kuwala is the no-code data platform for BI analysts and engineers enabling you to build powerful analytics workflows. We are set out to bring state-of-the-art data engineering tools you love, such as Airbyte, dbt, or Great Expectations together in one intuitive interface built with React Flow. In addition we provide third-party data into data science models and products with a focus on geospatial data.  Currently, the following data connectors are available worldwide: a) High-resolution demographics data b) Point of Interests from Open Street Map c) Google Popular Times
